conditions.displayName: Legacy BigQuery max_staleness below safe value in mock

inputs.displayName: Legacy BigQuery max_staleness below safe value in mock

documentation.content:
A legacy Datastream table in **mock** has a `max_staleness` below the safe value, perhaps lowered for debugging and not raised again; the incident's log entry names the tables.

Restore each with e.g. `ALTER TABLE <dataset>.<table> SET OPTIONS (max_staleness = INTERVAL 4 HOUR);`, see https://github.com/canton-network/splice/issues/2011
